Hi Sanjay — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and the items we agreed to follow up on so we can advance the procurement conversation: 

1) PII / payload scope: you mentioned telemetry contains request metadata plus tokenized identifiers (no raw card numbers). Can you confirm the exact fields in telemetry that may contain PII (email, user_id, order_id, ip_address)?

2) Retention and logs: you said metrics are kept for 90 days and raw request logs are archived for 12 months. Please confirm the retention buckets and whether logs written to S3 are immutable/backed by lifecycle rules.

3) Subprocessor list and telemetry vendor: you noted telemetry and app metrics are forwarded to CloudMon (Ava cc'd). We need a CloudMon contact and a short description of the data they receive (metrics vs. payloads).

4) Marketplace flows / third-party sharing: clarify whether any telemetry leaves MerchantLynx's AWS account to third-party marketplaces or analytics pipelines (especially any EU-bound destinations).

Next steps I propose: 
- Sanjay / Legal to share MerchantLynx data flow diagram and the vendor contact at CloudMon (attachment would be ideal).
- We will run a quick subprocessor risk check and return a minimal DPA addendum for telemetry processing.
- Set a 30-minute Security Ops workshop next week (Marissa and Neha will join). Proposed times: Wed 4/12 10:00–10:30am PT or Thu 4/13 9:00–9:30am PT.

Thanks Diego — appreciated. Quick answers below and I attached our internal data flow PDF. 

- PII / payload scope: telemetry includes: request_id, user_id (hashed), email (pseudonymized in most flows), order_id, ip_address (last octet redacted in telemetry stream). No full card numbers or CVV are included.

- Retention: application logs retained 90 days for hot logs; raw logs (S3) retained 12 months and then moved to cold storage. S3 lifecycle and MFA-delete enabled for the archive bucket.

- CloudMon (ava@cloudmon.com) receives aggregated metrics and sampled traces. They do not receive full request/response payloads unless explicitly enabled — which we have not enabled for MerchantLynx.

- Marketplace flows: we push anonymized metrics to the Partner Insights marketplace for aggregated dashboards. No identifiable customer payloads are sent externally. All storage is in AWS us-east-1. 

I've attached merchantlynx_data_flow.pdf. For the workshop, Thu 4/13 09:00am PT works for our team. Legal Ops (cc) — please flag any redlines. 

Regards,
Sanjay Patel
Head of Platform, MerchantLynx
